        A tweet from Tim Sweeney official account. 

Tim Sweeney
@TimSweeneyEpic

We have a huge pivot underway here at Epic, moving developers around to retool for maximum Al acceleration.
The aim isn't to do the same stuff with fewer people, but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal.
